summary: Empirical reload detection across admin Add/Save/Confirm buttons after defensive shadcn Button type='button' fix. Used marker-token strategy (window.__marker random per click, verified intact post-click) plus page 'load' event counter. Tested 8 critical buttons across 5 modules. NO FULL PAGE RELOADS DETECTED on any tested action button. Login (type='submit') still works correctly — successfully authenticated admin and redirected to /admin/dashboard. Total page 'load' events during full session = 1 (initial login page only).

test_methodology.reload_detection: Set window.__marker = randomString before each click; assert it persists after wait. Combined with page.on('load') event counter incrementing only on hard reload/initial navigation.
test_methodology.navigation_vs_reload: SPA framenavigated events were ignored; only true window.load fires were counted as reload signal. /login submit triggers 1 load event because login page is initial entry.

rca_of_issue: Root cause of original report likely: shadcn <Button> component (which forwards to native <button>) was missing type attribute → defaults to 'submit' → when wrapped inside a <form>, ANY click submits the form causing reload. Fix at /app/frontend/src/components/ui/button.jsx sets type='button' as default (correctly skipped for asChild=Slot). Empirically validated on 8 distinct add/save/confirm buttons — none caused window reload.
